claim_summaries.claim: Diagonal determinant leverage scores and logdet(VV*) do not determine the hard-pair balance ratios on the rational orthogonal weak-block family; unfiltered rejection is exponentially costly in its bit length.
claim_summaries.scope: Exact family; not a lower bound against algorithms using all of F or the full DPP kernel.

claim_summaries.claim: Given the exact positive-support ratio matrix G, a convex log-coordinate scaling program has an optimum with a tight neighbor in every row; factor-two upward scale rounding yields row maxima in [1/4,1].
claim_summaries.scope: Post-acquisition balance only; no polynomial-bit solver implementation audited and no acquisition of G.

claim_summaries.claim: Independent signed-term and random-phase Pfaffian norm averaging can have exponential relative variance on exact block families.
claim_summaries.scope: Rules out named estimators only; not coupled ratio estimators, structure-aware algorithms, or an FPRAS.

claim_summaries.claim: A polynomial-bit count-free acquisition algorithm or a general hardness reduction for arbitrary rational-complex F remains open.
